name: NEVKO-UI
texts: Adds a header button to switch to Big Picture or SteamVR
Buttons shrink a little when you click them
Chooses what the account button in the header shows
Clicking the emoticon button opens the menu as a panel beside the chat
Deleted messages that stay in the chat are shown slightly faded
Dock chats to the friends list
Draws menus inside the window or as separate popup windows
GIFs in the GIF tab play only on hover or all the time. On hover is lighter on performance
Hides avatar frames everywhere in Steam
Hides some or all of the minimize, maximize and close buttons
Hides the Friends and Chats tabs at the top of the friends list
Hides the Recent and Unreached Achievements sections in the achievements tab
Hides the Unread Messages group at the top of the friends list
Hides the What's New section, the Add Shelf button, or both on the library home page
Hides the small icon Steam shows next to custom usernames
Hides the unread message counter next to friends in the list
How "Last seen" is shown for offline friends, as Steam's usual text or as the exact time
How round avatars are across Steam, from square to a full circle
How round avatars with a profile frame are, so the frame still fits around them
How round buttons, menus and cards are across the theme
How round chat message bubbles are, from square to fully round
How round group chat and group avatars are, separately from regular avatars

Keeps deleted and expired messages in your chats. They're stored only on your PC. For now this can't be turned off while it's being tested, an option to disable it and clear saved messages is coming later
Keeps the voice chat panel visible even while you are in the voice channel's chat
Opens a chat when you double click a friend, instead of using the chat button
Places the emoticon and attachment buttons outside or inside the message field
Removes the profile button from the header and moves its useful buttons to the account menu
Removes the shine that runs across game covers when you hover them
Shows Steam emoticons as pictures while you type
Shows a Big Picture or phone icon next to your status, as if you were on that device
Shows a header with the friend's name and status, or Steam's tabs, at the top of the chat
Shows avatars next to messages in DM
Shows badges next to the names of Boosty supporters and people who helped with the theme (bug reports, fixes, ideas). Only people who use NEVKO-UI see them
Shows group chats above or below recent chats in the Chats tab
Shows online status as Steam's classic side bar or as a small dot on the avatar
Shows the friend's mini profile background behind the chat header
Shows the header buttons as text, icons, or both
Shows your own messages on the right or on the left of the chat
Size of emoticons in the emoticon menu
Size of stickers in the emoticon menu
Skips the age check on store pages with mature content
Stickers in the emoticon menu play only on hover or all the time. On hover is lighter on performance
Swaps the Store and Library buttons in the header
Turns the downloads button into a small icon with a progress bar
Uses Steam's original menus or the redesigned ones
Where the GIF tab searches for GIFs. Either service needs your own API key
Which emoji set is used in chats and in the emoticon menu
Which tab the friends list opens on
With the header on, opening a chat closes the others. When off, a button lists all open chats
